source.text: Harbor Voices exhibition brief: choose six oral-history clips, obtain listening-room permissions, and install headphones with captions for the winter opening.
Scanned permission form HV-4: exhibit clip at the Harbor Voices listening room; an additional permitted-use field is hidden by a folded page corner.
The language group separately commissioned a vowel-annotation corpus from Harbor Voices. Its research files and permissions are independent of the listening exhibition.
Camping stove pot support is loose at the hinge. Replace the retaining pin and test stability with an empty pan outdoors.
Unfolded HV-4 permission form: in addition to the listening exhibition, it authorizes this recording's inclusion in the separately commissioned Harbor Voices vowel corpus.

events.reason: The unfolded form in c06 shows that HV-4 also authorizes the vowel corpus. Keep the exhibition link and explicitly add the corpus link to the folded scan.

source.text: Exhibition edit: trim the long pause before the ferry story, but preserve the speaker's final sentence in the listening-room version.
Vowel corpus annotation guide: retain untrimmed pause boundaries and mark vowel intervals on the original Harbor Voices audio. Do not annotate the exhibition edit.

events.text: Exhibition edit revised: shorten, rather than remove, the long pause before the ferry story; preserve the speaker's final sentence in the listening-room version.

source.text: Exhibition caption proof: ferry-story clip, large text, transcript aligned to the final listening-room edit; the opening date remains on the back panel.
Listening-room installation walkthrough: six headphones play the edited Harbor Voices clips, and the ferry-story caption can be read from the seated position.
Vowel corpus quality check found two interval labels reversed. Correct them in the research annotation file before delivering the corpus to the language group.
Vowel corpus delivery manifest: original-audio references, corrected interval labels and permission HV-4 included. The language group accepted the research package.
Listening exhibition visitor review: the ferry clip is clear, but the caption's last line catches glare. Tilt that panel and record the adjustment in the exhibition report.
